GPT Image 2 提示词编写指南

本指南总结了编写高质量 GPT Image 2 提示词的核心技巧和常见错误，帮助你生成更精准、更符合预期的图像。

编写规则与示例

序号 技巧类别 规则 ❌ 错误示例 ✅ 正确示例 说明
1 反垃圾规则 视觉事实优于模糊赞美 A stunning ultra-detailed cinematic masterpiece of a woman in a museum, beautiful, photoreal, 8K, award-winning. Scene: A quiet classical museum gallery in soft afternoon light. Subject: A woman in her 30s standing casually in front of a large oil painting. Important details: Natural smile, realistic skin texture, beige knit sweater... 感叹词不会渲染成像素，用具体的视觉描述替代模糊赞美
2 反垃圾规则 风格标签需要视觉目标 minimalist brutalist editorial luxury photoreal cinematic modern premium Cream background, heavy black condensed sans serif, asymmetrical type block, one hero object, generous negative space, studio tabletop lighting. 堆砌风格关键词不如描述具体的视觉元素
3 反垃圾规则 说具体的事物 Make it more premium, more realistic, more stylish Replace the white dining chairs with natural oak wooden chairs. Preserve the camera angle and lighting. 直接说出要什么，而不是用形容词描述期望
4 编辑技巧 将更改与保留分开 Make it better and keep the good parts Change: Replace the background with a sunset beach. Preserve: face, identity, pose, lighting, framing. Keep everything else the same. 明确列出要改什么、要保留什么
5 编辑技巧 每次只做一个修订 Make it more premium, fix the text, change the outfit, improve the background, and keep everything. Make the light warmer. Remove the extra chair on the left. Restore the original wall texture. Keep everything else the same. 小步迭代比一次大改效果更好
6 文字渲染 将文本当作排版处理 Add some text about our product Headline (EXACT TEXT): "Fresh and clean" Typography: Bold sans serif, high contrast, centered vertically. No extra words. No duplicate text. 用引号标记精确文字，指定字体、大小、颜色和位置
7 结构化 使用五段式模板 A beautiful photo of a girl in a cafe Scene: A quiet cafe in the morning. Subject: A young woman reading a book. Important details: Warm window light, linen dress, shallow depth of field. Use case: Editorial lifestyle photo. Constraints: No watermark. Scene/Subject/Details/Use case/Constraints五段式结构
8 角色一致性 建立锚点并重复 Draw the same character in a new scene Keep the same face, same green hooded tunic, same proportions, same color palette, and same gentle personality. Same watercolor look. Do not redesign the character. 第一张图建立锚点，后续图重复关键锚点细节
9 风格迁移 说出各部分的名称 Use the same style as the reference image Use the same visual language: chunky pixel forms, limited arcade palette, bright glow accents, clean silhouette edges, playful 1980s poster energy. 描述具体的视觉元素而非抽象的风格名称
10 通用建议 万能提示词公式 A nice picture of something cool 描述主体 + 环境/场景 + 光线氛围 + 色彩风格 + 质感/细节 套用公式可以快速构建有效提示词
